issues.title: Ambiguous 'latest tag' probe logic
issues.why: 01-install-contract.md mentions 'middle-out, parallel, 2s timeout' probing for newer repos but doesn't define the discovery mechanism (e.g., GitHub API search vs. hardcoded list).
issues.fix: Define the specific GitHub API endpoint or naming convention used to discover 'newer' repos.

issues.title: Missing sample output for --dry-run
issues.why: AC-09 requires --dry-run to print 'WOULD: ' prefixed lines, but no example of this output is provided in the examples or contracts.
issues.fix: Add a code block showing sample stdout for a dry-run installation of the 4 default folders.

issues.title: Undefined behavior for partial folder failures
issues.why: If 3 of 4 folders download successfully but the 4th fails, the spec doesn't explicitly mandate a full rollback vs. leaving a partial install.
issues.fix: Add a clause to 01-install-contract.md requiring atomic folder moves or full cleanup of the destination on partial failure.
